title: Overall Satisfaction with Performance and Service
summary: Reviews in this topic consistently express broad satisfaction with the G60, often mentioning overall ownership, driving performance, quality, comfort, and dealer or branch service.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe owners as generally very satisfied with the car overall, with specific praise for performance, driving, quality, comfort, and service.

limitations: Most example fragments are brief expressions of satisfaction, so detailed reasons behind the positive sentiment are limited.
The topic combines several related but distinct aspects, including overall satisfaction, performance, driving, comfort, quality, and service, rather than one narrowly defined issue.
Examples are sentiment-stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the full review population.
